reason: I forget my pills at home all the time and travel a lot, so a pre-counted foil sachet I can toss in my bag is the first version of this that fits how I actually live. At $24.99 for the first box with the money-back guarantee, I'd try one box and not more.
objection: $29.99 is more than Toplux or Goli, and those last longer. I'm paying extra for the sachet and the lab report, and I don't know yet if magnesium does anything for my sleep.
would_change_my_mind: If the regular price were $29.99 with no launch discount, I'd skip it. Also if the lab report on the page turned out to be vague or not tied to the batch number.
